messages:
Hannah R: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners for remediation and decide on SLO vs alert tuning.
Jonas T: Root cause recap: autoscaler undershoot during a traffic surge, created a ~5m latency tail.
Meera: I checked error budget: weekly burn 0.8%, monthly still fine, but recurring small burns over last 45d.
slo-bot: Incident 2036998000: p95 breached to 620ms (SLO p95<450ms). Weekly burn increased by 0.8%.
Hannah R: Proposed actions: (1) Jonas owns autoscaler tuning; (2) Meera owns recurrence analysis + postmortem appendix; (3) Hannah to lead SLO review with Product.
Jonas T: I'll open RFC for autoscaler cooldown & scale-up smoothing. Target PR in 9 days, rollout in 14.
Meera: I'll run a 60d recurrence query and include deploy markers. Due Thu.
Hannah R: For alerts: keep p95 alert but add a p99 page. That way we catch noisy increases and escalate true tail regressions. Agree?
Meera: Agree. Also add a dashboard widget for queue depth and 99/95/50p latencies.
ops-bot: Created task SLO-712 assigned to Jonas T, due 2037009000.
Hannah R: OK, capture these in the postmortem tracker and meet next Tue 10am to decide on SLO recalibration if recurrence persists. Please paste PRs and dashboard links here. :thumbsup:
